FROM node:22-bookworm

RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    git ca-certificates chromium chromium-driver fonts-liberation \
 && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

WORKDIR /app

# Clone, pin to base commit, strip .git (anti-cheat: agent cannot inspect fix PR / future history).
# Re-init a single-commit repo so git apply works and verifier can reset test files.
RUN git clone https://github.com/recharts/recharts /app \
 && git -C /app checkout bf0460641dd33939e5b4b22feecdc629cc1407b6 \
 && rm -rf /app/.git \
 && git -C /app init -q \
 && git -C /app -c user.email=h@l -c user.name=h add -A \
 && git -C /app -c user.email=h@l -c user.name=h commit -q -m base \
 && git -C /app tag harbor_base

# Pre-install dependencies so verify time does not wait on the network.
# npm ci, not pnpm: this repo is an npm workspaces project and ships package-lock.json at the base
# commit. pnpm cannot read that lockfile, so `pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile` re-resolved every
# dependency from its semver range on each build - vitest, jsdom and @testing-library/react included -
# leaving the environment unpinned and the runs only accidentally reproducible. `npm ci` installs the
# exact tree the lockfile records and fails loudly if the lockfile and package.json ever disagree.
RUN npm ci

# Visual evidence — readable by the agent at /app/.harbor_assets/.
# tests/ and solution/ are supplied by the harness at verify time — NOT baked in.
RUN mkdir -p /logs /app/.harbor_assets
COPY assets/ /app/.harbor_assets/

CMD ["bash"]

18	}

24	# Paths come from the `diff --git` headers, not from `+++ b/`: binary and rename
25	# diffs carry no `+++ b/` line, so that form silently skips them and the suite
26	# scores 0 on every re-run after the first.

55	    name = ident.split("::", 1)[1] if "::" in ident else ident

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Behavioral verifier for recharts__recharts-6937-mm.
# Resets test files to harbor_base, applies test.patch, runs ONLY the configured
# f2p + p2p tests, computes reward.
# NEVER greps source for the fix — reward comes from the test report only.
set -uo pipefail

mkdir -p /logs/verifier
STDOUT_LOG=/logs/verifier/test-stdout.txt
STDERR_LOG=/logs/verifier/test-stderr.txt
REPORT=/logs/verifier/report.xml

: > "$STDOUT_LOG"
: > "$STDERR_LOG"

ensure_reward() {
  [ -f /logs/verifier/reward.txt ] || echo 0 > /logs/verifier/reward.txt
}
trap ensure_reward EXIT

cd /app || { echo "no /app" | tee -a "$STDERR_LOG"; exit 1; }

# ── Step 1: restore any test paths the agent may have edited ─────────────────
# Paths come from the `diff --git` headers, not from `+++ b/`: binary and rename
# diffs carry no `+++ b/` line, so that form silently skips them and the suite
# scores 0 on every re-run after the first.
echo "== restoring test files to harbor_base ==" | tee -a "$STDOUT_LOG"
_patch_paths=$( { sed -n 's#^diff --git a/\(.*\) b/.*#\1#p' /tests/test.patch
                  sed -n 's#^diff --git a/.* b/\(.*\)#\1#p' /tests/test.patch; } | sort -u )
for _p in $_patch_paths; do
  git -C /app checkout harbor_base -- "$_p" 2>/dev/null || rm -f "/app/$_p" 2>/dev/null || true
done

# ── Step 2: apply test.patch ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
echo "== applying test.patch ==" | tee -a "$STDOUT_LOG"
git apply --binary /tests/test.patch 2>>"$STDERR_LOG" \
  || git apply /tests/test.patch 2>>"$STDERR_LOG" \
  || patch -p1 -i /tests/test.patch 2>>"$STDERR_LOG" \
  || { echo "ERROR: could not apply test.patch" | tee -a "$STDERR_LOG"; exit 1; }

# ── Step 3: build the run set from config.json ───────────────────────────────
# Only f2p + p2p may run. The name filter is built from the leaf test names so it
# does not depend on how the reporter joins suite names; verifier.py then scores
# the fully-qualified ids exactly.
echo "== selecting f2p + p2p tests ==" | tee -a "$STDOUT_LOG"
TEST_FILES=$(python3 -c '
import json
print(" ".join(json.load(open("/tests/config.json"))["test_files"]))
')
NAME_FILTER=$(python3 -c '
import json, re
c = json.load(open("/tests/config.json"))
seen = []
for ident in c["f2p"] + c["p2p"]:
    name = ident.split("::", 1)[1] if "::" in ident else ident
    leaf = name.split(" > ")[-1]
    if leaf not in seen:
        seen.append(leaf)
print("|".join(re.escape(s) for s in seen))
')
echo "test files: $TEST_FILES" | tee -a "$STDOUT_LOG"

# ── Step 4: run f2p + p2p vitest tests ───────────────────────────────────────
echo "== running vitest ==" | tee -a "$STDOUT_LOG"
# shellcheck disable=SC2086
npx vitest run \
  --reporter=junit \
  --outputFile="$REPORT" \
  -t "$NAME_FILTER" \
  $TEST_FILES \
  >>"$STDOUT_LOG" 2>>"$STDERR_LOG" \
  || echo "(vitest exited non-zero; parsing report)" | tee -a "$STDOUT_LOG"

# ── Step 5: compute reward ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Scored from the behavioral f2p + p2p results only - nothing here is graded by eye.
echo "== computing reward ==" | tee -a "$STDOUT_LOG"
# Rubric judge — SUB-AGENT backend: no API key, no network. On the first pass there is no
# verdict yet, so judge.py writes a judge request under /logs/verifier/judge/ and prints
# nothing; scoring falls back to tests alone. Once a judge sub-agent has written
# verdict.json there, `mm_run.sh <task> rescore` folds the verdict into the reward.
# The `|| echo ""` is load-bearing: the judge must never be able to fail the run.
RUBRIC=""
if [ -f /tests/rubrics.json ]; then
  RUBRIC=$(python3 /tests/judge.py --rubrics /tests/rubrics.json --repo /app \
             2>/logs/verifier/judge.log || echo "")
  echo "Rubric verdict: ${RUBRIC:-pending (judge request written; rescore after grading)}"
fi

python3 /tests/verifier.py --rubric "${RUBRIC:-}"

echo "reward=$(cat /logs/verifier/reward.txt 2>/dev/null)" | tee -a "$STDOUT_LOG"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Behavioral verifier for recharts__recharts-6937-mm.

Reward policy (binary, no partial credit):
  1.0 - every f2p passes AND every p2p passes.
  0.0 - a strict subset of f2p passes, or any p2p regressed, or the suite failed to run.

Identifiers are resolved EXACTLY. An earlier revision matched them by substring and
took the first hit, which lets one test be scored using a different test's result as
soon as one configured name is a prefix of another.
"""
import atexit, json, os, sys, xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

CONF   = json.load(open("/tests/config.json"))
F2P    = CONF["f2p"]
P2P    = CONF["p2p"]
REPORT = "/logs/verifier/report.xml"
REWARD = "/logs/verifier/reward.txt"

_CANON_JSON = "/logs/verifier/reward.json"
_CANON_TXT = "/logs/verifier/reward.txt"
_canon = {}


def canon_reward(f2p_passed, f2p_total, p2p_passed, p2p_total, rubric):
    """THE reward policy for the whole corpus. BINARY -- there is no partial credit."""
    f, t = int(f2p_passed), int(f2p_total)
    p, q = int(p2p_passed), int(p2p_total)
    solved = bool(t) and f == t and p == q
    tests_passed = 1.0 if solved else 0.0
    _canon.clear()
    _canon.update({
        "reward": 0.0 if rubric == "fail" else tests_passed,
        "tests_passed": tests_passed,
        "f2p_passed": f, "f2p_total": t,
        "p2p_passed": p, "p2p_total": q,
        "rubric_passed": {"pass": 1, "fail": 0}.get(rubric, -1),
    })
    return _canon["reward"]


@atexit.register
def _canon_flush():
    if not _canon:
        return
    try:
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(_CANON_JSON), exist_ok=True)
        with open(_CANON_JSON, "w") as _h:
            json.dump(_canon, _h, indent=2)
        with open(_CANON_TXT, "w") as _h:
            _h.write(str(_canon["reward"]))
    except Exception as _exc:
        print("WARNING: could not write %s: %s" % (_CANON_JSON, _exc), file=sys.stderr)


def rubric_verdict(argv):
    """The verdict test.sh hands in as `--rubric pass|fail|""`."""
    if "--rubric" not in argv:
        return None
    i = argv.index("--rubric")
    value = argv[i + 1].strip().lower() if i + 1 < len(argv) else ""
    return value if value in ("pass", "fail") else None


def load_results():
    """Return {full_id: status} and {test_name: [full_id, ...]} from Vitest's JUnit XML."""
    by_id, by_name = {}, {}
    if not os.path.exists(REPORT):
        return by_id, by_name
    try:
        tree = ET.parse(REPORT)
    except ET.ParseError:
        return by_id, by_name
    for tc in tree.iter("testcase"):
        classname = (tc.get("classname") or "").strip()
        name      = (tc.get("name") or "").strip()
        full_id   = f"{classname}::{name}".strip(":")
        failed    = any(c.tag in ("failure", "error") for c in tc)
        skipped   = any(c.tag == "skipped" for c in tc)
        status    = "skip" if skipped else ("fail" if failed else "pass")
        by_id[full_id] = status
        by_name.setdefault(name, []).append(full_id)
    return by_id, by_name


def resolve(idents, by_id, by_name):
    """Exact resolution only.

    Primary key is the fully-qualified `<file>::<suite chain> > <test>` id. If the
    reporter spells the classname differently (absolute path, for instance), fall back
    to the test name alone -- but only when that name identifies exactly one test, so a
    duplicated name is reported rather than silently scored against its twin.
    """
    out = {}
    for ident in idents:
        if ident in by_id:
            out[ident] = by_id[ident]
            continue
        name = ident.split("::", 1)[1] if "::" in ident else ident
        hits = by_name.get(name, [])
        if len(hits) == 1:
            out[ident] = by_id[hits[0]]
        elif len(hits) > 1:
            out[ident] = "ambiguous"
        else:
            out[ident] = "missing"
    return out


def main():
    by_id, by_name = load_results()
    f2p = resolve(F2P, by_id, by_name)
    p2p = resolve(P2P, by_id, by_name)

    f2p_pass = [k for k, v in f2p.items() if v == "pass"]
    p2p_pass = [k for k, v in p2p.items() if v == "pass"]

    reward = canon_reward(len(f2p_pass), len(F2P),
                           len(p2p_pass), len(P2P),
                           rubric_verdict(sys.argv[1:]))
    print(json.dumps({"reward": reward, "f2p": f2p, "p2p": p2p}, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
